title: [finding] cli: `os package install` prints "installed into the running kernel" on any 2xx, so an install-local answer of `hotLoaded: false` (the lenient path) reads as a hot install
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect, class (a), reach measured at a public door** (`os package install`). Raised by #22695's dev (report `6101930151`, PR #22728) and filed by the `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024) · `session_019SvPnd2bzECRNmAU9i6E4k`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades it and names the lane. The reader is `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`, which is `domain:cli`'s by the lane table.

Blocked-by: #22695

It reads the key PR #22728 adds (`hotLoadError`, beside `hotLoaded: false`). It is additive, like the console's reader objectstack-ai/objectui#12098.

## Measured (by the dev, not re-run by the seat)

- A scratch probe ran `PackageInstall.run` in catalog mode against a stubbed install-local answer carrying `hotLoaded: false` and `hotLoadError`. It printed the success line `Package installed into the running kernel` and said nothing of `hotLoadError`. The probe was not committed.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts` (about `:224`) prints that success on any 2xx and reads neither `hotLoaded` nor `hotLoadError`.

So once PR #22728 lands, the server tells the truth on the lenient path (a cloud-fetched manifest whose hot-register throws), and the CLI still prints a hot install over a kernel that loads the package only at its next restart.

## Expected (a shape for triage, not a ruling)

- On `hotLoaded: false`, the command says the package is installed and loads at the next restart, and names `hotLoadError`.
- The `--json` face, if the command has one, carries the two keys as the server answered them.
- CONTROL: a hot-loaded install prints as today.

## Duplicate check

REST `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=all&since=2026-08-15` was paged to REST's page cap and merged with a `since=2026-10-10T17:00Z` read: 5,150 issues from #6015 to #22727, closed included, PRs excluded. Local case-insensitive grep over titles and bodies:
- `hotLoaded`: 1 hit, #22695 (the server half).
- `hotLoadError`: 0 hits.
- `installed into the running kernel`: 4 hits, all closed and on other defects of the same command (#21585, #21322, #21321, and the QA run #21318).
- Control term `install-local`: 42 hits.

Dedupe words: os package install hotLoaded · installed into the running kernel · hotLoadError CLI reader · install-local lenient path CLI
